biography: Guilherme Salas, a name synonymous with Brazilian motorsport's rising tide, hails from the vibrant streets of São Paulo. From a young age, Guilherme was captivated by the symphony of roaring engines, spending countless hours glued to the television, watching Senna's legendary battles. His journey began at the tender age of 10, tearing up local karting tracks in a 2-Stroke 125cc Shifter kart. A defining moment came during the Brazilian Karting Championship in 2015. Despite a mechanical failure in qualifying that relegated him to the back of the grid, Salas carved his way through the field with audacious overtakes, ultimately securing a podium finish and earning the attention of talent scouts. Following his success in karting, Salas transitioned to touring cars, joining Crown Racing and later KTF Sports. Although he is only 24, he has experience in a range of touring car competitions, including a stint with BMW. Now driving for KTF Racing, Salas is determined to leave a lasting mark on the sport, showcasing the raw talent that first ignited on the karting circuits of Brazil.
drivingStyle: Salas is known for his aggressive and flamboyant driving style. He attacks corners with a late-braking technique, often flirting with the limit of adhesion. While his raw speed is undeniable, tire management has been a recurring challenge, sometimes leading to late-race fade. Under pressure, Salas tends to become even more aggressive, often resulting in spectacular overtakes, but also occasional errors. He's a driver who thrives on adrenaline and the thrill of wheel-to-wheel combat, making him a constant threat on the track.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Alves
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, fueled by several on-track collisions and accusations of unsportsmanlike conduct.

rivalries.name: Isabela Flores
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor known for her tactical prowess, Flores often uses mind games to unsettle Salas, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Marco Costa
rivalries.reason: The veteran driver has been openly critical of Salas's 'reckless' driving style, leading to several tense moments in press conferences and team meetings.

quirks: Always wears a specific lucky pair of socks with a Senna design on race days.
Listens to Brazilian samba music at full volume in the paddock before every race.
Has a specific ritual of tapping the steering wheel seven times before the start of each session.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about pushing the limits and dancing on the edge of control. If you're not taking risks, you're not living."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Touring Car Championship race at Interlagos in 2022. Starting from P8, he executed a series of daring overtakes in the rain, securing his first major touring car victory in front of his home crowd.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the final race of the 2023 season while leading, costing him a chance at the championship. The incident was a result of pushing too hard in wet conditions and colliding with a barrier.
